hero.title: Christian Festa
hero.eyebrow: Director of Software Engineering · Agentic AI Engineer
hero.subTitle:
I've spent {YEARS} years as a consultant, and every engagement has been client-facing. Not the configure-someone-else's-software kind of consulting: full design, development, and integration (DDI) of custom systems. I've owned every seat in the SDLC, from requirements and UX design in Figma through hands-on development, systems and data integration, and test oversight, and I've run the whole lifecycle as a delivery manager directing teams of 30+.

Today I'm Director of Software Engineering, directing the teams behind a $40M AWS-hosted platform for a state agency client: secure generative AI on Amazon Bedrock with layered guardrails, the responsible-AI governance behind it, and the team building with two AI coding agents, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code.

I'm a hands-on engineer who works agentically: I design, architect, and code alongside Claude Code and MCP, working out the architecture with the agent before a line is written, then building, testing, and shipping. I've helped build multi-agent systems on Strands and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and automated program management across Jira and Confluence.

corporate.headline: Engineering & AI Leader · Director of Software Engineering · Generative AI, AI Enablement, Platform Delivery
corporate.summary: Engineering and AI leader who built a consulting firm's secure generative AI capability and the governance that lets it scale: Retrieval-Augmented Generation on Amazon Bedrock with layered guardrails and responsible-AI policy. I lead AI enablement across engineering, rolling out GitHub Copilot and bringing Claude Code and MCP into daily delivery, while directing a $40M AWS-hosted platform for a California state health agency with cross-functional teams of 30+. {YEARS} years delivering on regulated healthcare, eligibility, and criminal-justice data, contributing to $100M+ in winning proposals. PMP-certified.
highlights: Direct a $40M AWS-hosted grant management platform for a California state health agency with cross-functional teams of 30+.
Built the firm's secure generative AI capability: a RAG application on Amazon Bedrock that cut week-long work to hours with zero PII or IP exposure, plus the governance framework behind it.
Led AI enablement for engineering: the team develops with two AI coding agents, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code.
Delivery manager across three of four solutions on Hawaii's $100M BESSD welfare modernization; design, BA, development, and test reported to me.

projects.name: Ghosty Privacy
projects.printLine: A privacy firewall that stops the trackers, analytics, and telemetry apps send in the background, across every app on the phone, with no account and no server.
projects.description: A privacy firewall that lives on your phone. Ghosty stops the trackers, analytics, and telemetry your apps send in the background, across every app on the device, not just the browser. See what your apps look up, switch whole categories off with one tap, and pause it whenever you like. No account, no server: what Ghosty sees stays on your phone. Free tier plus monthly, yearly, and family Premium.
